home.title: Home alone, never on their own
home.description: Watch over older parents and children from afar with your home cameras.

detect.title: It recognises danger
detect.description: Falls, screams, long crying, breaking glass and fire alarms are detected by AI right away.

alerts.title: Alerts within seconds
alerts.description: Everyone in the family is notified. When one person says “I'm on it”, the others can relax.

privacy.title: No recordings kept
privacy.description: Only a snapshot of a dangerous moment is sent to you.
